mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS activityId, a.activity, a.content, a.time, a.avatar, a.pay, a.paytype, a.publishman, a.doman, a.domans, IFNULL(i.status, 0) AS status, IFNULL(i.usernum, #{userId}) AS usernum FROM Activity a LEFT JOIN Activityinfo i ON a.id = i.activitynum AND i.usernum = #{userId} WHERE a.deleted = 1
